# aft Drop

> Deploy a static site to a durable live URL instantly, with no account required to start.

## How it works

1. Drop a folder or `.zip` containing your static site (HTML, CSS, JS). Include an `index.html`.
2. aft Drop uploads it via `POST https://api.aft.page/v1/deploy`.
3. You get a live URL.
4. Open `claimUrl` (`https://aft.page/claim?slug=&token=`) to keep ownership.

Limits: 500 files · 25 MB / file · 100 MB total.

## For AI agents

Use aft Drop at https://aft.page/drop/ only when you have browser automation and a completed static site folder or `.zip` file to upload. After publishing, return both the live URL and the claim URL.

For agent workflows, prefer MCP instead of Drop:

- Remote MCP: https://mcp.aft.page/mcp
- Tools: `deploy`, `aft_deploys`, `aft_rollback`, `aft_health`
- Docs: https://aft.page/mcp.md
- Agent index: https://aft.page/llms.txt

Cursor / Claude config:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "aft-page": { "url": "https://mcp.aft.page/mcp" } } }
```

Or deploy over HTTP:

```sh
curl -X POST https://api.aft.page/v1/deploy \
  -H 'content-type: text/html' \
  --data '<!DOCTYPE html><html><body><h1>shipped by agent</h1></body></html>'
```

For multi-file sites, use multipart `POST /v1/deploy` with `fileN` + `fileN_path`, or MCP `deploy` with `files`. Ensure the site includes `index.html`.

After claim: private invite, rollback, and custom domains (request access, CNAME to `cname.aft.page`).

After deployment, return:

- The live `https://{slug}.aft.page` URL
- The `claimUrl` (`https://aft.page/claim?slug=&token=`; keep editToken)
- The deploy `notice` when present (unclaimed sites deleted after 30 days idle)

Treat the edit/claim token as sensitive.
